title: GopherCon 2015: Go GC: Solving the Latency Problem - Rick Hudson
summary: Rick Hudson's GopherCon 2015 talk on Go 1.5's new low-latency concurrent garbage collector. It covers the motivation, performance numbers, technical challenges and why the approach fits Go.
why: Pointed to as the authoritative source on Go's GC pause improvements, and later revisited when GC latency claims were challenged.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: you might also find Rick Hudson's talk on GC improvements in Go 1.5 interesting
